1945, June 15
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
COLLEGE OF ST. THOMAS ST. PAUL, MINNESOTA
June 150 Feast of the Sacred Head (Octave of the SS. Cordis
Quam Bonus Israel ~~ Deus! ! !
Thanks be to God! At midnight the end of the first day of our "vacation" and trip to Fires nephew's (John Mccloskey, S. J. 's) First Holy Mass -- Seattle, Wash'ton. Just a week and a day since Rt. Rev. Edw'd, with Patrick and Owen -- three brothers arrived at Detroit, (Mich) -- St. Bonaventure Monastery.
A week to-day June 7 we were fortunate in hav- ing a real, private interview with the great "Radio Priest" of a decade ago (and since) , Rev. Charles E. Coughlin. He seemed appreciatively relieved to remark: I am just up to the Third Nocturn, anticipating the Feast of the Sacred Heart." For years there had been dreamings of a "Family Reunion" on occasion of the First Holy Mass of said nephew John Mccloskey, S. J. Now the questions could I go -- should I go?
We had not been together since our dear par -- ents golden wedding in 1913 (32 yrs) -- they with the eldest of sixteen and the 4 of her 10 brothers, having gone ahead, we have hep trust to a happy eternity, R.I.P. But Fr. Maurice Joachim, one of the ten brothers was had not been well. Some doubts were expressed as to whether he were able to make the trip. I told them I'd decided not to go unless F.M could go along. ..... The above named three wert left for baltimore to see Maurice . : . Saturday a.m. June 94. .. Following Friday at 8:30 a.m. came the telegram:
" ... Capuchin Monastery ... Detroit. Maurice with us on Bando, due Chicago Thursday nine oclock. Can you meet us at Dean Conley's? Edward. "
(No Signature)
